content: The development of this proprietary brand was initiated in 2004 by the company's in-house blending team. In early 2006, the company collaborated with Pepin Garcia and his son, Jaime Garcia, to achieve the desired final blend. This blend was successfully introduced to the market in late February 2007. The cigars are manufactured in Estelí, Nicaragua, at Tabacalera Cubana (TACUBA), with production carried out by various manufacturers on behalf of the company. The cigars are full-bodied, featuring a Nicaraguan Corojo wrapper, a Honduran binder, and Nicaraguan filler. They are packaged in cellophane and presented in slide-top, cabinet-style boxes containing 20 cigars each.
